Squirrels are rodents.  They are brownish-gray in color and have a long, bushy tail.  Some squirrels can fly.  Squirrels eat acorns and climb trees.  They usually live in forests but can also be found in the Grove at Ole Miss.  These squirrels are fearless.

Pizza is food.  It consists of a bread crust, is covered with sauce and usually topped with cheese, meat and vegetables.  Pizza is eaten often by college students.  It is Italian food.  There are several different kinds of pizza.  Many cities, such as Chicago and New York, have their own styles of pizza making.
